programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a colorful and exciting 3D animated show full of music, dancing, and fun adventures! It follows BarryTiger and his lovable friends as they play, learn, and discover new things every day. With happy songs, cheerful characters, and amazing places to visit, each episode brings smiles and laughter. The music is made by real musicians, so every tune is catchy and sounds great! Get ready to sing along, move to the beat, and have a roaring good time with BarryTiger!

programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 23 - O Sequestro dos Cientistas Tetsunin Steel (Tetsunin Gamesshu) Dr. Smith

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 24 - O Capitão Pirata Suinin Tubarão Mor Tōha(Jiraiya), Rei Yagyū(Kinin Reiha) e Ryū Asuka(Yanin Spiker)
programme.desc: Toha, seus irmãos e Ryu desconfiam que os Feiticeiros estão planejando algo em um resort próximo. Logo descobrem um tesouro submarino e são atacados por Suinin Tubarão-mór

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 25 - O Rapto dos Animais Jūnin Makunba e seu irmão mais velho Manabu e Kaio Tsumoto
programme.desc: Ninguém sabe o que acontece. Os animais de estimação do bairro inteiro estão desaparecendo. O responsável é ninguém menos que Makunba, o ninja caçador. Mas ele não havia sido derrotado?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 26 - A Primavera de Emiha Nukenin Kei(Himenin Emiha), Kaminin Oruha e Shin Yazaka
programme.desc: O homem que esconde o segredo de uma antiga ruína: Shintarou Yasaka. Procurando seu paradeiro Jiraya e os demais são atacados pelos Yonma. Durante a batalha, Kei é envenenada e para salvá-la, chega o pesquisador Shintarou.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 27 - Jiraiya, o inimigo de Toha (Nenhum) Tōha(Jiraiya) e Yajirō Iyo
programme.desc: Diante de Touha, surge um novo inimigo e seu nome, estranhamente, é Jiraiya. Qual a verdadeira identidade dele? Qual o segredo escondido por trás disso? Vestindo a Jiraiya Suit ele avança sobre o indefeso Touha. Touha terá chance de vencê-lo?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 28 - Quem sou eu? Adolf Sugitani (Sugitani Akunobō) Tōha(Jiraiya) e Tetsuzan Yamashi
programme.desc: Afinal, quem sou eu? A chave é o homem misterioso que aparece em Shinshu, no tempo de Togakushi. Quem é o Akunobou Sugitani que esconde-se em meio à montanha?

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Issamu, Joe e Shigeru são capturados e levados para o templo da Princesa Garonia. Maribaron ordena que Joe e Shigeru sejam eliminados.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Shigeru quer observar esquilos-voadores que atingem 10 mil metros de altura no céu. Porém, um esquilo em específico chama a atenção de Issamu e Joe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Nascem dois sóis em Tóquio, mais uma operação maléfica em movimento pelo Império Crisis.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Bancos são roubados e uma única prova do crime intriga a polícia: cascos de bananas. Issamu e Joe Kazumi levam o caso a sério e tentam bolar um plano para atrair alguém aficcionado por bananas.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 33 - A Guitarra Cobiçada Tōha(Jiraiya) e Rainin Wild
programme.desc: Chega um telegrama de desafio do Rainin Wild. Uma covarde armadilha é montada pelos Yonma e assim começa uma luta decisiva. No limite da batalha entre a arma e a espada qual será a condição imposta?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 34 - A Caveira Assassina Monstro Feiticeiro Gomaz Família Yamashi e Rei Yagyū(Kinin Reiha)
programme.desc: Uma misteriosa luz envolve a família Yamaji . Qual será o maior perigo de todos que o pote de herança prevê? E qual será o segredo da inscrição?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 35 - O Desafio dos Togakure Monstro Feiticeiro Gomaz, Commando e Killer Tōha(Jiraiya) e Deus Jirai
programme.desc: Surge o Deus Jirai, que se manifestou para defender Toha da família de Feitceiros que invocou o monstro gigante Yonma. Deus Jirai seria a entidade protetora de Jiraiya? Algo extraordinário está para acontecer! Lute Jiraiya!

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 36 - O Feitiço do Gato Preto Yaminin Devilcat Tōha(Jiraiya), Kei(Himenin Emiha), Manabu e Henri Rakuchin
programme.desc: Em um canto obscuro da cidade grande uma sombra negra move-se sorrateiramente. Jiraiya investiga incidentes que ocorreram segundo as previsões de um médium suspeito. Será que este médium tem alguma previsão para nosso ninja?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 37 - O Homem de 2300 Anos Uchūnin Del-Star (Uchūnin Demost) Tōha(Jiraiya), Rei Yagyū(Kinin Reiha) e Jōnin Barão Owl
programme.desc: Jiraya procura respostas sobre o paradeiro do tesouro do século através das escrituras do Deus Jirai. Porém, Dokosai também está atrás do tesouro e Jiraya fará de tudo para protegê-lo. Go Jiraya!

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 38 - As Mil e Uma Faces Oninin Dokusai e Aracnin Morgana (Yōnin Kumo Gozen = "Ninja Feiticeira Madame Aranha") Tōha(Jiraiya) e Tetsuzan
programme.desc: A família de Feiticeiros mais uma vez tentar exterminar Jiraya e é resgatado por seus amigos. Morgana retorna e se reúne com Dokosai para encontrar Pako e destruir o Deus Jirai.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 39 - A Conspiração de Morgana Aracnin Morgana e os Mini-Karasutengus Kei(Himenin Emiha) e Manabu
programme.desc: A academia de Jiraya não vai muito bem e surge uma nova academia de ninjas. A diretora da escola é Morgana e aprisiona todas as crianças reprovadas para entrar na escola. O que será que ela está tramando? Jiraya conseguirá salvar as crianças?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 40 - A Traição Tetsunin Steel 002 Tōha(Jiraiya), Kazenin Storm, Rainin Wild e Hōnin Jane
programme.desc: Uma desconhecida ninja do império procura Tetsuzan Yamashi e encontrar sua localização de Pako. Jiraya então ajuda a nisei a encontrar o local nas minas.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 41 - Olímpica VS Satã Uchūnin Del-Star e Igyōnin Beni Lagarto(controlado pela magia da Espada Satã) Tōha(Jiraiya)
programme.desc: Uchūnin Dell-Star tem um sonho e percebe que nunca combaterá Jiraya sem sua antiga espada, Satã, porque ela é a única que pode derrotar a espada Olímpica. O caçador de espadas também está a sua procura. O que acontecerá?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 42 - Adeus, Mamãe Segundo Sainin Gyūma Família Yamashi e Akiko
programme.desc: É o aniversário da morte da mãe dos Yamashi e Marabu fica sentido por não guardar nenhuma lembrança, porém ela aparece misteriosamente depois de 8 anos. Será que a mãe deles não morreu? Será que pode ser mais um plano da família dos feiticeiros?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 43 - O Indomável Strover Shakunin Strover Tōha(Jiraiya)
programme.desc: Strowver, um antigo desafiante Tetsuzan reaparece para vingar a perda de seu braço arrancado pelo nisei. Toha fica cego pela força do ninja tirano e as forças malignas se unem para destruir Jiraya enquanto está fragilizado.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 44 - O Poder do Amor Família de Feiticeiros Bakunin Homem-Míssil
programme.desc: O Homem Míssil pede ajuda de Jiraya para proteger Tao, uma menina criada como filha do herói depois da Guerra no Vietnã, mas eles são surpreendidos pela família de feiticeiros que sequestra a menina e levam a foguete do Homem Míssil .

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: O grande profeta Edin previu a aparição do maligno deus das trevas Satan Goss. Edin convocou Jaspion para defender o Universo e derrotar Satan Goss.

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: Daileon faz um pouso forçado no planeta Peace. Lá, Jaspion conhece o satélite artificial Sakura que controla o planeta e seus habitantes bestiais.

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: Jaspion se depara com o monstro Namaguederaz, um monstro pacífico que foi atingido por uma flecha venenosa. O menino Koko, que convive com o monstro, revela que só a fruta da vida pode salvá-lo.

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: Edin acha que a Terra, por ter sido antigamente habitada por vários monstros, seria um alvo em potencial de Satan Goss.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja

programme.desc: A família Yamashi começa a desconfiar de Reiha. Logo são atacados por Otonin Uhaya, o ninja do som.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja

programme.desc: Manabu se revolta quando aprende na escola que vários animais já foram extintos por causa dos humanos. Logo depois Juunin Makunba, um ninja criminoso e caçador de animais em extinção, atenta contra a vida de Tetsuzan.

Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can't help being sucked in by Moose's relentless optimism and zest for life!

programme.title: Tom's Car Wash
programme.desc: Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Pumpkin Reports
programme.desc: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Requiem
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le rouleau du Démodragon
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'épéiste oublié
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cœur du démon
programme.desc: Kavaxas a besoin du cœur de Shredder pour le ressusciter. C'est Don Vizioso qui s'en est emparé et qui le conserve dans une fiole. Les tortues et Tiger Claw vont tout faire pour le lui reprendre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin des temps
programme.desc: Shredder prend le pouvoir et détruit le sceau. Kavaxas est libre, il ouvre le portail du Royaume des Ténèbres et les revenants déferlent sur Terre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...
programme.sub-title: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...
programme.desc: Maître Splinter réunit ses quatre fils, pas encore adolescents. Il leur raconte en détail la genèse de leur histoire, et leurs débuts dans les rues hostiles de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La malédiction de Savanti Romero
programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La crypte de Dracula
programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature du docteur Frankenstein
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les monstres attaquent
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Un vaisseau se dirige vers la Terre. Le lieutenant Iguissg'ba et le commandant Gazéwroka ont reçu l'ordre de prendre en chasse un mercenaire en cavale, K'Vathrak, qui n'est autre que le Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 2e partie
programme.desc: Mikey a pris une décharge électrique fatale. Dregg débarque sur la planète avec son vaisseau, les tortues tentent par tous les moyens de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (1/3)
programme.desc: Les tortues pensent être parvenues à vaincre leurs anciens ennemis, mais elles vont vite s'apercevoir qu'un nouveau mal est à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (2/3)
programme.desc: À la recherche du Kuro Kabuto, Karaï se prétend héritière légitime du Clan des Foot quand elle tombe nez à nez avec un vieux rival.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (3/3)
programme.desc: L'animosité de Donatello envers Don Vizioso met la mission des tortues en péril.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Yojimbo
programme.desc: Les tortues débarquent dans un monde féodal peuplé d'animaux anthropomorphes.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Osoroshi no Tabi
programme.desc: Après avoir échappé aux soldats de Sumo Kuma, les tortues doivent affronter les Tanukis, des créatures versatiles, et Joroguma, la terrible femme-araignée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Kagayake ! Kintaro
programme.desc: Il reste quelques étapes aux tortues, à Usagi et à Kintaro, avant de rallier le temple-palais du Bouddha Céleste. Mais prudence, l'emprise de Jei n'est jamais loin...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le guerrier des terres dévastées
programme.desc: Une bombe de mutagène a ravagé la Terre. Dans ce futur post-apocalyptique, Raph et Donnie affrontent le Clan des Blaireaux Maraudeurs du Bitume.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le désert infranchissable
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Donnie le robot, Raph et Mira partent à la recherche du Grand Booyakasha qui peut déchiffrer la carte qui mène à Oasis.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Carmageddon
programme.desc: Raph met le cap sur Oasis, poursuivi par Maximus Kong. Le combat s'engage.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Splinter autorise enfin les tortues à remonter à la surface. Elles tentent de secourir une jeune fille mais s'aperçoivent qu'elles ne savent pas se battre en équipe.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 2e partie
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent qu'April et son père sont retenus prisonniers par les Krangs, de méchants extraterrestres déguisés en robots androïdes. Les tortues réussiront-elles à pénétrer dans le repaire de l'ennemi et à combattre en équipe ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue
programme.desc: Raphael perd son sang-froid quand un vieux New-Yorkais fait une vidéo des Tortues Ninja en train de se battre contre les Krangs. Les tortues doivent mettre la main sur cette vidéo avant qu'elles ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi
programme.desc: Pour prouver que les tortues ninja peuvent se lier d'amitié avec des humains, Michelangelo se fait un ami sur un réseau social. Mais cet ami est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Lorsque les tortues quittent le repaire contre l'avis de Splinter, elles font la rencontre de Baxter Stockman, un inventeur dérangé vêtu d'une armure de combat.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'Acier
programme.desc: Las d'utiliser son bô contre la technologie extraterrestre des Krangs, Donatello crée Tête d'Acier, un robot télécommandé, pour se battre à sa place.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Malin comme un singe
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur la disparition d'un scientifique, Donatello et April croisent la route d'un singe au comportement bizarre et découvrent un complot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Xever la menace
programme.desc: Léo pourrait regretter d'avoir fait preuve de clémence, quand Xever prend en otage le propriétaire d'un restaurant de nouilles chinoises.
